name: ∞-Category Inner Horn Filling Constraint via cvc5
description: cvc5 SMT proof of inner horn filling in ∞-categories (Joyal model)

test_positive_inner_horn_lambda_2_1.description: cvc5 SAT: inner horn Λ^2_1 fills in X (∞-category)

test_positive_inner_horn_lambda_3_1.description: cvc5 SAT: inner horn Λ^3_1 fills in X (∞-category)

test_positive_inner_horn_general.description: cvc5 SAT: inner horn Λ^n_k (0 < k < n) fills for n ≥ 2

test_negative_unfillable_inner_horn.description: cvc5 UNSAT: unfillable inner horn violates ∞-category axiom

test_negative_outer_horn_fill_requiremen.description: cvc5 UNSAT: requiring outer horn to fill violates Joyal model

test_negative_invalid_horn_dimension.description: cvc5 UNSAT: inner horn with n < 2 is invalid (horn filling requires n ≥ 2)

test_boundary_minimal_lambda_2_1.description: cvc5 SAT: minimal inner horn Λ^2_1 has unique filler

test_boundary_high_dim_horn_lambda_5_2.description: cvc5 SAT: high-dimensional inner horn Λ^5_2 fills

test_boundary_symbolic_horn_filling.description: sympy: symbolic encoding of ∞-category inner horn axiom
test_boundary_symbolic_horn_filling.joyal_axiom: ∀ inner horn Λ^n_k → X (n ≥ 2, 0 < k < n): ∃ unique filler
test_boundary_symbolic_horn_filling.outer_horn_exception: Outer horns Λ^n_0, Λ^n_n may fail to fill (composition/source)
test_boundary_symbolic_horn_filling.inner_horn_property: Invertibility: inner horns must fill (higher morphisms invertible)
test_boundary_symbolic_horn_filling.equivalence: X is ∞-category iff inner horn filling condition holds
